visual.general_description: Four-panel figure: axial ear CT, culture plate photograph, Gram stain microscopy and mass spectra.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A is a grayscale axial CT slice with a red arrow at the image-left mastoid region. Panel B is a photograph of a red agar plate with pale streaked growth and an enlarged inset. Panel C is a magenta-stained microscopy field with an enlarged inset. Panel D is a pair of stacked red mass spectra over a 2000 to 12000 mass axis.

panels.general_description: Grayscale axial CT image of the head in bone window with a red arrow pointing at the image-left mastoid region.
panels.detailed_description: Axial CT slice through the skull base on a black background. The skull is bright white, brain tissue and the posterior fossa are mid-gray, and the nasal cavity, paranasal air spaces and external ears are visible. A red arrow in the lower left of the skull base points at a mastoid area on the image-left side where the bone shows a mottled pattern of dark air spaces and bright septa. The corresponding area on the image-right side also shows dark air spaces within bone. No text, scale bar or side marker is visible on the image.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Grayscale axial slice with bright bone, black air and soft-tissue gray

evidence.quote: (A) Planar bone window CT images to visualize the condition

evidence.quote: CT examination revealed opacification of the right middle ear and mastoid (Figure 1A)

pixel_observations: Grayscale axial CT slice with bright skull bone and a red arrow pointing at the image-left mastoid region.
The mastoid area indicated by the arrow shows a mottled mix of dark air spaces and bright bone septa.
No text, scale bar, patient-side marker or other annotation is visible apart from the red arrow.

panels.general_description: Photograph of a red agar culture plate with whitish-gray streaked growth and a circular magnified inset of a colony edge.
panels.detailed_description: Top-down photograph of a round Petri dish with a deep red medium. Pale grayish-white growth forms streaks across the plate in a zigzag streaking pattern. A thin circle marks a region near the lower edge of the plate and two thin lines connect it to a larger circular inset at the right showing the same colony edge enlarged, with a pale, slightly lobed border against the red medium. No text, scale or labels are visible.

evidence.quote: (B) The colony morphology of Kerstersia gyiorum

pixel_observations: Round Petri dish with red medium and pale grayish-white streaked growth.
A circular inset at the right enlarges a colony border from a circled area near the lower plate edge.
No labels, scale or text are visible.

caption_claims.value: Caption states panel B shows the colony morphology of Kerstersia gyiorum; the case text describes colonies on blood agar as grayish-white, moist with irregular, scalloped, serrated margins

evidence.quote: (B) The colony morphology of Kerstersia gyiorum
displayed grayish-white, moist colonies with irregular, scalloped, serrated margins (Figure 1B)

clinical_significance.statement: The case text describes the colony morphology of the predominant strain on blood agar and cites Figure 1B.

evidence.quote: The strains cultivated on blood agar plates showed an irregular surface, lacked hemolysis, and displayed grayish-white, moist colonies with irregular, scalloped, serrated margins (Figure 1B).

limitations: The medium type, hemolysis and margin morphology are not confirmed from pixels; they come from the case text.

panels.general_description: Microscopy field of small magenta particles on a pale background with a boxed region enlarged in an inset at the right.
panels.detailed_description: Field of many small magenta-pink particles and clumps scattered across a pale gray-white background, with larger dense clusters at several places. A rectangular box on the field is joined by two thin lines to an enlarged inset at the right that shows individual small magenta rod-like and dot-like bodies. No scale bar or text is visible.

evidence.quote: A pure culture of the isolated strain was collected for Gram staining and observed under a standard light microscope.
(C) The result of Gram staining microscopy of Kerstersia gyiorum (1000×)

pixel_observations: Dense field of small magenta particles on a pale background with several clusters.
A boxed region is enlarged in an inset showing separate small magenta bodies.
No scale bar or text is visible.

caption_claims.value: Caption states panel C is the result of Gram staining microscopy of Kerstersia gyiorum at 1000× magnification

evidence.quote: (C) The result of Gram staining microscopy of Kerstersia gyiorum (1000×)

clinical_significance.statement: The case text states Gram staining revealed Gram-negative bacteria, pink, non-uniform bulbous or rod-shaped, and cites Figure 1C.

evidence.quote: Gram staining revealed Gram-negative bacteria, manifesting as either pink, non-uniform bulbous, or rod-shaped (Figure 1C).

limitations: Cell shape and Gram reaction are not interpreted from pixels; the colours shown appear digitally uniform and the magnification is taken from the caption.

panels.general_description: Two stacked red mass spectra with peak labels, x axis ticks from 2000 to 12000.
panels.detailed_description: Two red line plots stacked vertically that share one horizontal axis with ticks at 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 6000, 7000, 8000, 9000, 10000, 11000 and 12000 and a very small axis label. The upper trace has a header line with small text and the lower trace has a header line with small text ending in smoothing wording. Both traces show a dense cluster of tall peaks just below 5000 to just above 5000, a peak near 6000 to 6500, a group of peaks around 7000, one peak near 8500 and a broad low peak near 10000. The lower trace carries small black numeric peak labels in parentheses. A percent-intensity axis with ticks 0 to 100 is printed beside each trace.

measured_quantities.value: relative peak intensity versus mass axis
measured_quantities.visual_cue: Two stacked red spectra with sharp peaks along a numeric mass axis

limitations: Peak labels and instrument header text are too small and low resolution to transcribe digit by digit; no readings are recorded.
The x axis label is too small to read.

(D) Mass spectrometry image of Kerstersia gyiorum

The lower trace has small black numeric peak labels that are too small to transcribe reliably.
Tallest peaks cluster just below and at 5000 with a further tall peak near 6300 and a group near 7000.

visual.general_description: Four-panel genome analysis figure: circular genome map and COG, KEGG and GO classification bar charts.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A is a circular genome map with concentric colored rings and center text. Panel B is a vertical bar chart of gene counts per COG letter class. Panel C is a horizontal bar chart of gene counts per KEGG category. Panel D is a three-facet bar chart of gene counts per GO term.

panels.general_description: Circular genome map with concentric colored rings and the genome size and GC text printed in the center.
panels.detailed_description: Circular genome map on a white background. From the outside inward there is a thick teal ring with small coordinate tick labels around its outer edge, a thin pale line trace, a purple trace that fluctuates around a circle, a thick blue ring, a salmon-pink histogram-like ring and an innermost ring of many short blue and a few orange and green segments. A narrow white gap interrupts the inner rings at the right. Center text reads "size: 5079440 bp" and "GC: 50.78". A small legend at the right with very small text lists colored swatches for the traces and rings.

evidence.quote: (A) Genomic map of Kerstersia gyiorum
(A) Genomic map of Kerstersia gyiorum

pixel_observations: Concentric rings in teal, pale line, purple, blue, salmon and a blue segmented inner ring, with a narrow gap at the right.
Center text printed "size: 5079440 bp" and "GC: 50.78".
Small legend text at the right and the coordinate labels around the outer ring are too small to transcribe.

caption_claims.value: Caption states panel A is a genomic map whose outermost circle gives the position coordinates, showing annotation results for coding and functional genes from outside to inside

evidence.quote: (A) Genomic map of Kerstersia gyiorum. The outermost circle of the picture is the position coordinates of the genome sequence, showing the distribution of annotation results for coding gene and functional genes from outside to inside.

clinical_significance.statement: The case text reports the complete genome length, G+C content and predicted gene counts and cites Figure 2A.

evidence.quote: The complete genome of Kerstersia gyiorum is 507,9440 bp in length, with a G+C% content of 50.78%, and contains a total of 5,219 predicted genes, 99 tRNA and 22 rRNA genes, which are illustrated in Figure 2A.

limitations: The map center prints the genome size with different digit grouping from the text; the printed pixel values are kept only here and not used as clinical facts. Legend and coordinate text are not legible.

panels.general_description: Colored bar chart of gene counts per COG function class with a legend naming the classes.
panels.detailed_description: Vertical bar chart with 22 differently colored bars labeled with single capital letters from C to X along the x axis titled "Function Class" and a y axis titled "Number of genes" with ticks 0, 200 and 400. Small numeric labels sit above each bar. The tallest bars are those for letters G, E and C, and the shortest are for letters W, D and U. A legend titled "Group" at the right lists the 22 letters with category names such as energy production and conversion and extracellular structures.

panels.general_description: Horizontal colored bar chart of gene counts per KEGG pathway category with a class legend.

Bars are colored by class, with a legend titled "Class" naming cellular processes, environmental information processing, genetic information processing, metabolism and organismal systems. Small numeric labels sit to the right of each bar. The longest bar is the carbohydrate metabolism row in the metabolism color, and several rows at the top have almost no visible bar length.

panels.general_description: Three-facet bar chart of gene counts for GO terms grouped by biological process, cellular component and molecular function.
panels.detailed_description: Three side-by-side panels with gray header strips reading "biological_process", "cellular_component" and "molecular_function" share a y axis titled "Number of genes" with ticks 0, 250, 500, 750 and 1000. The x axis is titled "GOterm" and each facet has many bars with rotated text labels that are too small to read. In the biological_process facet all bars are short, below about 100 on the axis. In the cellular_component facet three bars are much taller than the rest, reaching roughly 600 to 1000. In the molecular_function facet a few bars reach roughly 400 to 450 and the rest are short. Bars are colored by class in red, green and blue with a legend titled "Class". Tiny numeric labels sit above the bars.
